title: Umurinzi w'ikimenyetso cy'Imana
intro: Mu mutima w’ubuturo bwera, roho nziza yarezwe iyobowe n’Imana. Uyu muntu yari agenewe kugira uruhare runini mu gikorwa cy’igitangaza, aba igihamya cy’imbaraga n’ubwenge bya Allah bitagira imipaka. Urugendo rwabo rwahishuye ukuri gukomeye, rugerageza imyumvire no gushyiraho ikimenyetso kidasanzwe ku bantu bose.
clues: Natoranijwe kandi ngatunganywa n'Imana kurusha abagore bose bo mu gihe cyanjye.
Nashyizwe munsi y'uburinzi bw'umuhanuzi w'umukiranutsi, wabonye ibimutunga mu buryo bw'igitangaza mu cyumba cyanjye cyo gusenga.
Nitandukanije n'umuryango wanjye njya ahantu hiherereye ho gusengera Allah.
Marayika yanyeretse mu ishusho y'umuntu utunganye, anzaniye inkuru y'umwana w'umuhungu utunganye, nubwo nta mugabo nari nzi.
Nyuma y'ububabare bwo kubyara, nategetswe kuzunguza igiti cy'umukindo kugira ngo mbone ibiryo bishya.
Ubwo nasubiraga mu muryango wanjye ntwaye umwana wanjye w’uruhinja, barambajije ibibazo, ariko umwana wanjye w’uruhinja yavuze mu buryo bw’igitangaza kuva mu bwana bwanjye andegura.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Gutabwa mu muriro ugurumana kubera guhakana ibigirwamana
Kuvuka k'umwana udafite se mu buryo butangaje
Kumirwa n'ifi nini kubera kureka ubutumwa
trial.answer: Kuvuka k'umwana udafite se mu buryo butangaje

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Inyanja yacitsemo kabiri kugira ngo abantu bambuke
Umwana wavuze kuva akiri umwana arengera umubyeyi we
Ihishurwa ry'igitabo cy'Imana kugira ngo kiyobore abantu
outcome.answer: Umwana wavuze kuva akiri umwana arengera umubyeyi we

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allāh has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds. (3:42)
